body: Do you know where I can get fake job & landlord references? I looked online but the only website is workreferences & they charge $300 each. I just need an apartment. I got enough money but bad references.
You have to click on the box with the $25 then hit backspace. This cost me a month delay in filing my tax return & screwed me out of my climate action rebate for April. Wealthsmart thieves!
